items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: Willie Humphrey, Poisey Humphrey, and the other one, I forget his name now.

ctx.x: Well, quite a few bands, but I couldn't remember them right now by name, but they had quite a few. I mean, they had so much music down there at night that it sounded like one trying to outdo the other.
Did you know any of the Humphrey family?
Willie Humphrey, Poisey Humphrey, and the other one, I forget his name now.
